description.value: Mariner Brewing is a craft brewery and taproom in Coquitlam specializing in a rotating lineup of house beers. The taproom includes a full kitchen focused on smash burgers, plus an outdoor patio that welcomes dogs. It hosts community events and actively donates to local causes, giving it a neighbourhood-hub character that touring cyclists passing through the Tri-Cities area may find welcoming.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is an active brewery and taproom at 1100 Lansdowne Drive, Coquitlam, BC — notably the OSM community tag says 'North Vancouver' but the website clearly locates it in Coquitlam, a discrepancy flagged below. Phone and email match OSM tags exactly. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; the FAQ confirms outdoor seating/patio and growler fills, which are the only takeout-adjacent evidence found.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website and all address references place the business in Coquitlam, BC V3B 5E2 — the OSM community tag appears incorrect.
OSM record has no address tag; address sourced entirely from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active brewery taproom with on-site food and outdoor patio; a legitimate food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists moving through the Coquitlam/Tri-Cities area. Bike-specific amenities are unconfirmed but the business is clearly cycle-visitor-friendly.

Takeout.detail: Growler fills explicitly offered ('Do you do growler fills? Yes! Our growler fill lineup changes frequently'); beer to go confirmed. Food takeout not explicitly confirmed

wow_evidence: craft brewery and taproom; outdoor patio that welcomes dogs
